decision.observation: A woman with green hair and a red scarf is at the open booth window and says, "Papers, please." No passport is visible on the counter yet.
decision.hypothesis: Waiting briefly will let her finish speaking and place her passport on the counter for inspection.
decision.memory: Every entrant needs a passport; only Arstotzkan citizens may enter. Inspect nationality and expiration, stamp the passport, then drag it directly onto the entrant to return it.
